content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I'm using [product_name] for automatic transfer supply (ATS) in a low voltage distribution system. It works fine when I interlock 3 or 4 air circuit breakers (ACB), but managing 5 ACBs becomes much more complicated. Currently, I need to switch to a more advanced PLC to handle this. Did I overcomplicate the setup in your opinion? Thanks! Visit my forum: [url]
Hi, Could you provide more details about your issue? It's a bit difficult to understand your exact situation. Also, it appears your forum doesn't use English.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to use [product_name] for ATS control in a low voltage distribution system. While interlocking up to 4 ACBs is manageable, moving to 5 ACBs increases complexity and reveals limitations in the product's logic handling. This forces the user to upgrade to a more capable PLC, leading to increased effort and potential workflow changes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to easily manage interlocking for 5 or more ACBs, seeking better scalability and simplicity in moderately complex systems.
